entities.name: Darko Miličić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Darko Miličić is a Serbian former professional basketball player. He is 2.13 m, and played the center position. He played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) from 2003 to 2013. Nicknamed "the Human Victory Cigar" for only playing in blowout wins or losses, Miličić is the fifth youngest player and the youngest foreign player to have played in the NBA, the youngest player to have played in an NBA Finals game, and the youngest player to win the NBA championship.
